page.layout: One block of running text in a single full-width column, from top to bottom. No marginal notes. The red edge of the neighbouring page at the right is not printed text. Below the last line, at the right, one catchword.

main_text.p: regi, polemarcho, thesmothetis, tum in jure dicundo, tum in aliis reipublicæ negociis curandis specialius & certius quàm fuerant ante, à Solone descriptæ.

Præmium omnibus magistratus hujus probè ac sine vitio gesti tributum ab eodem, adscriptio in Areopagitas, quorum honos cum amplissimo munere erat perpetuus. Præter hoc ix.virûm collegium, de quo dicendum rursus, ubi de magistratibus hujus reipublicæ variis & multis agetur, Solon distincta in civitate concilia esse voluit, præcipua nempe & maxima ejus membra, ex quorum apta compagine reipublicæ à se ordinatæ forma existeret. Horum amplissimum erat Concio, in quam coibat universus populus, & cujus erat suprema in civitate potestas: de qua etiam plura suo loco. Huic verò tan-quam grandi navi fluctuationi & tem-pestatibus obnoxiæ alia duo adjuncta fuêre velut ancoræ ejus, ut loquitur Plutarchus, quæ proprie senatuum ti-tulo afficiebantur. Eorum alter aliquo-ties jam memoratus, ex loco, ubi con-ventus & confessus sedem habebat, A-reopagiticus fuit nuncupatus: quem ante Solonem in civitate non fuisse, veterum quidam videntur existimasse.
Cicero quippe lib.1. off. sic ait: Lau-

page.notes: The catchword at the lower right is only partly legible; "detu" is a guess ([?]). The word "Lau-" at the page foot is cut off by the edge of the scan and may continue on the next page. Long s is printed as f in the original and is written here as plain s. The printed "distinâta" and "ampliffimo" are normalised to "distincta" and "amplissimo" under that rule. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
